serious. Very bad and worrying; needing attention.
preserve. To keep something safe and as it is.
climate. The usual weather in a place over a long time.
affected. Changed by something from outside.
home. The place where you live.
cause. To make something happen.
energy. Power that gives light, heat or moves machines.
recycle. To make used things into new things.
overpopulation. Too many people living in one place.
nuclear. Using power from splitting atoms.
